complete_literal_source_proposal.title: Fill-budgeted elimination of large-prime relation components
complete_literal_source_proposal.claim: R3 representation at the decomposition/relation stage. A fill-budget policy can lower total relation collection plus linear algebra cost by >=20% relative to a fixed large-prime/cycle policy at the same memory cap. It need not improve yield or exponent.
complete_literal_source_proposal.mechanism: Object: a bounded-fill elimination forest on auxiliary relation columns. Operation set Sigma: pivot an auxiliary column, merge its incident equations, and project the certified result to base columns. Trichotomy: coordinate-dependent; this is a solver/representation object, not a lossy quotient under the full group translation action. Discarded information: auxiliary logarithm variables are eliminated; combination coefficients retain a group-verifiable certificate. Collect partial relations with at most two auxiliary points from a separately priced large-prime set. Maintain components with exact modular coefficients and only eliminate pivots whose predicted fill remains under f_max. Compare cheap cycles, deferred dense cores and discarded components by cost per independent projected row. The added mechanism is adaptive algebraic sparsification with a proof of the exact projection, not raw cycle counting.

target_complexity.end_to_end_conditional_cost: Let U be independent logarithm unknowns after every legitimate quotient, C_att the full state-conditional attempt cost, and eta=inf_history E[Delta_rank|history] a proposed positive drift bound. Only if this bound holds is E[T_rank] <= C_setup+U*sup_history(E[C_att|history])/eta justified; add all sparse LA, target descent, transport and verification costs. If eta=0 or unknown, do not replace it by mean tuple yield. With B=N^beta, p_hit=N^-delta, per-attempt cost N^sigma, and rank gain conditional on a hit N^-rho, the conditional collection exponent is beta+sigma+delta+rho; sparse LA is a separately justified expression, often N^(2beta) under bounded row weight. None of beta,delta,sigma,rho is measured here.
